name: Leon Edwards

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (74 in height, 74 in reach); 170 lb at the UFC 322 weigh-in (Nov 2025)

photo_coverage: Good. ESPN headshot and stance-left were uploaded during UFC 322 week (Nov 2025). Two profiles (Mar 2025, Nov 2025), a recent flash-lit frontal and a warm-light three-quarter. One freely licensed photo (Commons, 2021). A Commons file 'Leon Edwards UFC BELT 2023.png' (CC BY-SA 4.0) was left out: it looks like an official UFC promo cutout uploaded as 'own work', so its licence is doubtful. He has not fought since Nov 2025, so there is no 2026 fight photo.

face.shape: Long oval, lean. Narrower than it is long, tapering through a beard-covered jaw to a moderately narrow chin.
face.jaw: Moderately wide, softened and squared off by the beard. In profile (03, 04) the jaw line is clean and slopes gently to the chin.
face.chin: Medium width, slightly long, moderate projection, under the beard
face.cheekbones: High and well defined; the cheeks below are lean/hollow
face.forehead: High, made to look higher by the receding temples; smooth and rounded

eyes.shape: Almond to slightly round, medium size, with a calm, slightly heavy-lidded look

eyebrows.shape: Gently arched, tapering at the outer ends

nose.tip: Rounded, moderately broad, with medium-wide nostrils

face.mouth_lips: Medium width; full lips with a full lower lip. Neutral at rest; wide smile with even teeth (Commons 2021).

ears.note: Sit slightly out from the head

face.notable_marks_scars: A small round reddish-dark mark on the upper right chest below the collarbone (ESPN headshot). A few small dark spots on the cheeks/forehead (cagesidepress photo).

hair.style: Very short buzz cut, even all over
hair.colour_note: Black. The buzz is short enough that scalp skin shows through, so render it as a dark tint over skin rather than strands.
hair.hairline: Receded at the temples into a rounded M; the front centre sits at roughly the normal height
hair.texture: Tightly coiled (visible as a dense, even buzz)

facial_hair.detail: Dense full beard about 1 to 2 cm long, joined to the moustache, trimmed to a clean, fairly high cheek line and a neat neck line under the jaw
facial_hair.colour_note: Black (jaw sample #2b1917). No visible grey as of Nov 2025.
facial_hair.shape: boxed full beard following the jaw, slightly fuller at the chin

skin.tone_hex_method: average of the cheek samples only (forehead samples sit on specular highlights in every photo); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma percentile pixels of the patch
skin.freckles_marks: Small dark spots on the cheeks and forehead; a small reddish mark on the upper right chest.
skin.note: The ESPN grade is very warm (cheek samples #bf512e and #db633d), and the flash photo is lifted. The three-photo cheek average (#c4724b) is a reasonable midpoint. He reads lighter and warmer than Kamaru Usman in comparable light.

body.build: Long-limbed, lean, athletic welterweight (188 cm, 77 kg)
body.body_fat_note: Abs visible in both ESPN cutouts
body.shoulders: Moderately broad and squared, with defined deltoids
body.chest: Flat, well-defined pectorals of medium thickness
body.arms: Long and lean, with defined biceps and forearms
body.legs_calves: Long legs with lean thighs; slim calves
body.notable: Long neck and long limbs relative to his frame. He looks taller and slimmer than Usman.

tattoos.description: Script reading 'Death Before Dishonour' in two lines
Several lines of script near the collarbone, with a black-and-grey vertical portrait/figure below it on the upper right chest
A vertical column of large script letters running down the ribs (not readable at the available resolution)
Black-and-grey forearm piece, dense, from the elbow toward the wrist

kit.fight_shorts: Black/grey patterned UFC shorts with crypto.com logo (2025); red Venum shorts (2022); black with gold trim as champion (2023-2024)
kit.walkout: Black Venum hoodie with gold UFC lettering (champion era)

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set. They are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs.

morphs_unavailable: No hairline-recession or beard-shape targets: do these in the hair/beard textures. No ear targets in the shipped manifest (a small forward rotation is under morphs_if_available).
notes: Confidence: medium-high for the overall look (long oval face, receding buzz cut, dense boxed black beard, high cheekbones, long lean frame, chest scripts); medium for morph values. What to watch for: (1) the receding temple hairline is important for the likeness and must be in the scalp texture; (2) the beard is dense and neatly edged, so do not render stubble; (3) keep him slimmer and longer-limbed than Usman; (4) no 2026 photos exist because he has not fought since UFC 322 (Nov 2025), so the Nov 2025 photos are the most current; (5) macro/heightUpM uses a linear fit to the two MPFB2 builds in research/assets.md (height slider 0.30 -> 1.61 m, 0.62 -> 1.89 m, so slider = 0.5 + (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 and heightUpM = 2 * (slider - 0.5)). Muscle and weight also change stature slightly, so measure the built mesh and nudge heightUpM until it matches the listed height.
